$comment: EXP-1291 Threads v2: the Threads page (rail entry Threads, concept nav-threads; the composer on top) and the rail's Agents section, ×4 in the existing styleguide list (a filled group band, no count, over FLAT gapless rows, NO dividers ×4, EXP-1320). partitionThreads({sessions, sessionIssues, issues, messages, teamId}) = the roots of kind `thread` (teamId = the ACTIVE team on web/desktop; null = every team, phones band rows per team) grouped `needs_you` (any non-ended session of the tree has needsInput) · `running` (else any session queued or running) · `recent` (the rest), each by the tree's newest updatedAt desc (ties by id); empty groups omitted; Needs you and Running uncapped, Recent per `recent` (NEW-1, below). A row = the thread title (session-thread.json sessionTitle, EXP-1341), NO lock (EXP-1339), a spinner while busy, an amber dot when needsYou; ONE quiet trailing word off the team's PRs, EXP-1309. listAgents(agents, sessions, teamId, me) = the team's `agents` rows (NEW-2: definitions, never sessions) by sortOrder, then name, then id, each icon + color like a board row (missing → `agentDefaults`); busy / needsYou come from the viewer's OWN conversation session with the agent (a root with `agentId` and `userId == me`; none = false); the section sits above Boards and opens the agent's conversation (the same Conversation + composer). Reference packages/domain-contract/src/session-tree.ts; mirrors replay `cases` and `agentCases` comparing the WHOLE expected value. EXP-1312: threadRowMarkState({needsYou, busy}) = the lead of a thread row outside the Threads tab (home Running band, the rail Running rows, work tabs) x4: needs_you (the brand mark with the amber badge) beats working (the working mark), else waiting (the bare brand mark); markCases replay it. EXP-1318 (owner 2026-10-14): ONE row ×4 = lead mark (EXP-1344: threadRowMarkState FIRST, at every depth ×4: needsYou → the amber badge BEATS busy → the working mark, a parked plan/question keeps the device busy; then the ROOT's PRs, never the word (NEW-41, owner 2026-10-22): ANY open PR, a stacked one too → pr-open emerald, else a merged one → pr-merged VIOLET on every client incl. the IDE, else no PR glyph; threadRowLeadPr(prStates) = `open` | `merged` | null, `leadCases` replay it ×4, a stacked open PR is just another `open` state) · the title (no separate identifier slot: sessionTitle names it) · trailing = the word (EXP-1339: no lock). The word = threadRowWord({pullRequests, busy, needsYou, inStack}) (keys; `copy.words` = the text; EXP-1339: `merged` has NO text, it only turns the lead pr-merged violet), order stack → readyToMerge (an open PR while nothing works) → merged → question; inStack = threadInStack(threadPrs, teamPrs) (an open PR based on another open PR, or one based on it); mirrors replay `wordCases` + `stackCases`. Group bands carry their glyph ×4 (Needs you = coding-needs-input amber, Running = the working mark, Recent = ui-check), no count. Phones (teamId null): the TEAM band is OUTER (the filled team section header with the avatar), the group bands sit inside it, page title = `copy.title` in each platform's own root-screen header (Android: the large in-content headline its roots share; iOS: the sticky inline nav-bar title its other tab roots use, EXP-1358). The rail (web + IDE) = ONE band `copy.rail` = railThreads(groups, wordOf): every needs_you row, every running row, then the recent rows whose word is readyToMerge or stack, in that order (`railCases`, input words by sessionId); both list every thread the shapes make visible (no own-user filter). EXP-1318 (owner 2026-10-15): the device icon is back ×4: row trailing = word · the DEVICE ICON (list-item.json SessionRow anatomy: the title line + the trailing device glyph). The row's `deviceId` = the ROOT session's logical device_id (null when unset or absent: mirrors read a missing field as null); the icon = that device row's icon through the `deviceIcon` concept map, tooltip/accessibility label = the device name; a device the viewer cannot see (not in their synced devices) or a null deviceId → no icon. Rail rows (railThreads) carry the same field. EXP-1323 (owner 2026-10-15): rows carry `depth` (0 = the thread, opens the thread), `parentId`, `rootId`, `unread`, `caption`. A tree in Needs you or Running nests EVERY non-aside descendant right after its root (depth-first, the tree's creation order, depth = levels below the root) as SessionRow depth + TreeGuides (14px/level, the 3px corner tee); a child row = its session card name, its own busy/needsYou (false once ended), its own deviceId + caption, activityAt = its updatedAt, and opens that session; Recent collapses to the root. `reads` = the viewer's `session_reads` {sessionId, readAt} (absent = none): a root is `unread` when the tree's newest agent-authored message (any session of the tree, cards included) is newer than the read of the ROOT; a child when its OWN newest agent message is newer than its own read; no agent message = read. Unread = a bold title ×4; threadsUnread(groups) (any depth-0 row unread) = the Threads nav dot (`unreadCases`). `caption` = the session-card rule. Rows animate between bands on motion tokens. NEW-1 (plan 3.13): `recent` = Recent holds every tree with activity in the last `recent.hours` and, beyond those, fills up to the last `recent.max` by activity (`now` input; absent = no window, the last `recent.max` only; `recentCases` replay it with `now`). treeState(tree, pullRequests, now) = a tree's derived state for every surface that colours a thread: `needs_you` (a live session waits on a person: a card, a usage wall or a watchdog flag all set needsInput) · `running` (any session queued or running) · `done` (every session ended and every PR of the thread merged; a thread without a PR is never done) · `stale` (nothing touched for `treeState.staleHours`) · else `idle`; `treeStateCases` replay it. A thread's issues ×4 = the UNION over its tree's `session_issues` rows (NEW-1: a row sits on the session that holds the issue; `assignedSessionId` is gone), the root's rows first, then each child's in creation order, every issue once. recentCases: expected = the Recent group's ROOT session ids in order (other groups empty).

cases.name: the active team: needs you, running, recent; agents and other teams left out; a root's device rides its row (a child's never; an absent field reads null)
phones (every team) band rows per team
EXP-1323: a running tree nests its children depth-first with captions (asides stay out), Recent collapses to the root, unread follows the viewer's reads

agentCases.name: agents of the active team by sortOrder then name, defaults filled, state from my own conversation
every team on a phone; a member without a conversation sees a quiet row

markCases.name: needs you wears the amber badge

stackCases.name: a lone open PR is no stack
another thread's open PR is based on it
a merged base no longer stacks

wordCases.name: an open PR in a stack
a stack beats working and a question
an open PR while nothing works
an open PR while working = no word
waiting on a person, a closed PR never counts

railCases.name: needs you, running, then recent rows that still ask for a merge
only recent, nothing to merge = empty

unreadCases.name: an unread thread lights the nav dot
an unread CHILD alone never lights it

recentCases.name: 22 recent trees: the last 20 by activity (the 3 inside the window are among them)
the window keeps every tree active in the last 24 h even past the cap

treeStateCases.name: a live child waiting on a person = needs you
a walled session (needsInput held by the server) = needs you
queued or running beats everything but needs you
all ended, every PR merged = done
all ended with an open PR is not done: stale after 24 h
all ended without a PR, touched today = idle
an idle tree untouched for more than 24 h = stale
an idle tree touched within 24 h = idle

leadCases.name: an open PR beats a merged one
a closed PR alone = no glyph
an open stacked PR (word stack) still leads emerald
